sloka: एते दुष्प्रसहा राजन् बलिनः काम रूपिणः ।दैत्य दानव सम्काशा युद्धे देव पराक्रमाः ॥६-२८-३॥।।
transliteration: ete duṣprasahā rājan balinaḥ kāma rūpiṇaḥ ।daitya dānava samkāśā yuddhe deva parākramāḥ ॥6-28-3॥।।

translations.english: "O King! like a banyan tree on the island, like Sala trees on the Himalayan Mountain these people are stationed. You may see them marching. They are strong to encounter, can change form at their free will. They look like gods and Danavas in war and have the valour of gods."
translations.hindi: ये सब के सत्र दुर्धध, बलवान और इच्छा-रूपधारी हैं और दृत्यदानवॉको तरह बलसम्पन्न तथा युद्ध में देवतओं की तरह पणक्रमी;हें
